summary: Full retest of the Weight & Surface Area feature after its 2-field rework (was 7 fields in iter75). Backend: 13/14 pytest tests pass (1 skipped: no unlinked components exist in this catalog to test the 'no SAP link -> 404' branch). New GET /api/bom/net-weight endpoint verified end-to-end. Frontend Admin: dialog shows exactly 2 fields (Net Weight kg + Surface Area in²), no dropped 7-field UI remnants, Pull Current SAP shows '—' (expected: custom fields not linked to QueryMaterialIn yet), Save Locally persists across dialog close/reopen (verified 3.75/255 on SPC5WM), Push to SAP returns clean actionable error toast (no raw 500 leak / no ASGI traceback - the iter75 timeout wrapper is now working; SAPMaterialError-based error handling confirmed). Frontend BOM Explorer: exploded BOM 100010102-A and confirmed the new blue net-weight badges render exactly where components have a locally-set net_weight_kg: 'bom-net-weight-100002693-D1' -> '1.42 kg' and 'bom-net-weight-100002693-C1>SPC5WM' -> '3.75 kg'. Components without a net weight value show NO badge (correct). No console errors on any page. React key warning from iter75 is fixed (Fragment now correctly keyed on outer). Regression: existing drawing icon (bom-drawing-*) siblings still present, ECN comments still work, admin page search/list/columns still render. Cleanup done: 1 test session, 1 test user, and net_weight/surface_area values on SPC5WM/100002693-D1 all removed.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/admin/components/{product_id} still uses upsert=True (see server.py update_component around ln 1830) - flagged in iter75 - would silently create a component_master row for an unknown product_id. Low-risk since the endpoint is admin-only but tightening to update-only-existing would be safer.

Save Locally does not auto-close the dialog after a successful PATCH; UX-wise most save-and-close forms in this app close on success (see MSL push dialog). Minor - not a defect, just an inconsistency. If desired, close dialog on save success.
